of 1964
[Approved by the National Assembly of Pakistan on the 14th
March, 1964, see Gaz. of P., 1964, Ext., pp. 1586-158c.]
[30th January, 1964]
An Ordinance to provide for disqualifications for legal practice in certain
cases
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Legal Practice
(Disqualifications) Ordinance, 1964.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Definitions

THE LEGAL PRACTICE (DISQUALIFICATIONS) ORDINANCE, 1964

An Ordinance to provide for disqualifications for legal practice in certain
cases
2. Definitions.---In this
Ordinance, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,-
(a) " Judge
of a High Court " includes any person who has, at any time after the
fourteenth day of August, 1947, held office in Pakistan as the Chief Justice or
the Chief Judge, or as a Judge of any High Court or Chief Court in Pakistan, or
as a Judicial Com missioner or as a Member of a Judicial C6mmis sioner's Court
in Pakistan, but does not include a temporary, acting or additional Judge of
High Court or Chief Court ; and
(b) " Judge
of the Supreme Court " includes any person who has, at any time after the
fourteenth day of August, 1947, held office in Pakistan as the Chief Justice or
as a Judge of the Federal Court of Pakistan or the Supreme Court of Pakistan,
but does not in clude a temporary, acting, additional or ad hoc Judge.

Disqualification for legal practice in certain cases

THE LEGAL PRACTICE (DISQUALIFICATIONS) ORDINANCE, 1964
THE LEGAL PRACTICE
(DISQUALIFICATIONS) ORDINANCE, 1964
ORDINANCE No. II
of 1964
[Approved by the National Assembly of Pakistan on the 14th
March, 1964, see Gaz. of P., 1964, Ext., pp. 1586-158c.]
[30th January, 1964]
An Ordinance to provide for disqualifications for legal practice in certain
cases
3. Disqualification for legal
practice in certain cases.--Notwithstanding anything contained in any other
law for the time being in force, a person shall be disqualified, and, if he had
been carrying on legal practice, or had been enrolled as an advocate or
pleader, before commencement of this Ordinance, shall, upon such commencement,
stand disqualified, from pleading or acting,-
(a) if such
person has held office as a Judge of the Supreme Court, in or before any Court,
authority or tribunal in Pakistan ; and
(b) if such
person has held office as a Judge of a High Court, in or before any Court,
authority or tribunal in Pakistan except-
(i) the Supreme
Court, and
(ii) the High
Court the territorial limits of whose jurisdiction do not extend to any area
which was within the territorial jurisdiction of the Court in which he last
held office as such Judge.

Repeal
